en_title: KFC Australia Is Holding a Fake Funeral for Ann Alibi So You Can Take the Day Off for GTA 6
cn_title: KFC Australia正为Ann Alibi举办一场假葬礼，让你能请假玩《GTA6》
opus_summary: KFC Australia将为Ann Alibi举办假葬礼，让玩家请假玩《GTA6》，也可到场领取免费炸鸡。活动将在Instagram直播；若相关帖子达到6000个赞，公司将在游戏发售当天于澳大利亚全境提供免费配送。

paragraphs.en: When famous people die, they break attendance records for funerals all the time. I have a feeling the upcoming funeral for the definitely real Ann Alibi might blow those attendance numbers out of the water though.
paragraphs.cn: 名人去世时，他们的葬礼总会打破出席人数纪录。不过，我有种感觉，即将举行的、绝对真实存在的Ann Alibi的葬礼，出席人数可能会远远超过那些纪录。

paragraphs.en: KFC Australia is hosting a fake funeral so players can book work off for GTA 6 . Or you could actually attend the funeral and get some free chicken — it depends what your priorities are.
paragraphs.cn: KFC Australia正在举办一场假葬礼，让玩家可以为了《GTA6》向公司请假。或者，你也可以真的去参加葬礼，免费吃点鸡肉——这取决于你更看重什么。

paragraphs.en: “Ann Alibi was always there for us. Now you can be there for her,” the company said in an Instagram post .
paragraphs.cn: 该公司在一篇Instagram帖子中说：「Ann Alibi一直都在我们身边。现在，你可以为她到场了。」

paragraphs.en: “Join us Thursday 19 November for a funeral at KFC ROBINA, QLD, streamed live on Instagram from 11am AEDT. Any resemblance to a certain launch date is purely coincidental.”
paragraphs.cn: 「请于11月19日星期四前来参加我们在昆士兰州KFC ROBINA举办的葬礼，葬礼将从澳大利亚东部夏令时间上午11点起在Instagram上直播。与某个发售日期相似纯属巧合。」

paragraphs.en: The post is currently at 5.5k likes, but if it reaches 6k the company will offer free delivery throughout Australia for GTA 6 launch day. If you can’t get to Australia for a fake funeral and some free chicken, KFC plans to livestream the event. The service includes "a hearse, coffin, floral tributes, a book of condolences, an order of service and even a heartfelt eulogy delivered by a surprise guest."
paragraphs.cn: 这篇帖子目前有5500个赞，如果达到6000个，该公司将在《GTA6》发售当天为澳大利亚全境提供免费配送。如果你无法前往澳大利亚参加一场假葬礼、吃点免费鸡肉，KFC计划对活动进行直播。葬礼包括「一辆灵车、一副棺材、献上的花束、一本吊唁簿、一份仪式流程单，甚至还有一位神秘嘉宾发表的真挚悼词」。

paragraphs.en: According to statistics, GTA 6 has already caused a 17% spike in time off requests at work this week as hype hits fever pitch for the game’s long-awaited launch.
paragraphs.cn: 据统计，随着人们对这款游戏期待已久的发售热情达到顶点，《GTA6》已经使本周的工作请假申请数量激增了17%。

paragraphs.en: Some companies have already got ahead of things. Palworld developer Pocketpair has given employees five days off to work their way through GTA 6’s open-world Florida.
paragraphs.cn: 一些公司已经提前采取了行动。《幻兽帕鲁》开发商Pocketpair给员工放了五天假，让他们在《GTA6》的开放世界佛罗里达州中游玩。

paragraphs.en: If you want to keep up with all the news, follow along with our GTA 6 live blog , where we’ll be dropping all the news, collating all the buzz, and keeping everyone in that last-day-of-school vibe.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你想跟上所有消息，请关注我们的《GTA6》实时博客，我们将在那里发布所有新闻、汇总各方热议，让大家保持那种学期最后一天的氛围。
